title: IT Support – Legacy Software & Reporting
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Configure, deploy, and troubleshoot legacy software and runtime environments.
* Develop, modify, and maintain complex SAP Crystal Reports.
* Integrate reporting systems with .NET/C\#/Java applications.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, views, and stored procedures.
* Troubleshoot driver, COM, permission, installation, and Windows compatibility issues.

**Requirements:**

* Hands\-on experience with SAP Crystal Reports 9/XI.
* Strong knowledge of C\#, .NET/Java and relational databases.
* Advanced SQL optimization skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical abilities.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
